title: textContent used throughout web client — XSS via message content correctly prevented
description: app.js uses textContent (never innerHTML) for all peer-supplied content: message bodies, sender names, contact names, attachment filenames. A future contributor might 'simplify' rendering by switching to innerHTML for rich-text support. That change would introduce XSS. The current uniformity is deliberate and must be preserved. Any rich-text rendering must go through a sanitizer (e.g. DOMPurify), not raw innerHTML.
